about.description:
mortgagemath produces lender-style amortization schedules using Decimal
arithmetic end-to-end, with configurable rounding modes and currency
units. Supports fixed-rate and adjustable-rate mortgages, interest-only
periods with recast, balloon payments, and non-monthly payment cadences.
Ships a command-line interface and has no runtime dependencies beyond
the Python standard library.
about.summary: Cent-accurate mortgage amortization for Python, validated against 46 published sources across 6 countries

name: mortgagemath
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: mortgagemath
  version: "0.7.1"
  python_min: "3.11"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e5c242a124730c6b506779bccdd32e171c2053adc431d572a382cb8a263b46e3

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - mortgagemath = mortgagemath.__main__:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - hatchling
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - mortgagemath
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - mortgagemath --version
      - mortgagemath selfcheck

about:
  summary: Cent-accurate mortgage amortization for Python, validated against 46 published sources across 6 countries
  description: |
    mortgagemath produces lender-style amortization schedules using Decimal
    arithmetic end-to-end, with configurable rounding modes and currency
    units. Supports fixed-rate and adjustable-rate mortgages, interest-only
    periods with recast, balloon payments, and non-monthly payment cadences.
    Ships a command-line interface and has no runtime dependencies beyond
    the Python standard library.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/murraystokely/mortgagemath
  repository: https://github.com/murraystokely/mortgagemath
  documentation: https://mortgagemath.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - murraystokely
